title: Chicken and Prawn Laksa
description: A creamy coconut and chicken laksa with prawns, egg noodles and a homemade chilli and lemongrass paste.
ingredients: 400ml (14fl oz) can of light coconut milk
finely grated zest and juice of 1 unwaxed lime
2-3 chicken breasts (total weight about 400g/14oz), chopped small

LAKSA PASTE: 1 red chilli deseeded, 1 lemon grass stalk trimmed and roughly chopped, 2 garlic cloves, 2.5cm piece fresh root ginger peeled, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 40g flaked almonds, 2 spring onions roughly chopped, 2 tbsp water
TO SERVE: coriander leaves, lime wedges
steps: Put all the paste ingredients into a mini chopper and blend until smooth.
Use a large nonstick casserole dish. Fry the paste gently in spray oil for 2 minutes, then add the hot stock, coconut milk, sweet chilli sauce, lime zest and juice and turmeric.
Bring to the boil, add the chicken, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 20 minutes.
Add the prawns and noodles (make sure the noodles are submerged) and simmer for a further 5 minutes, or until the noodles are cooked through.
Stir in the beansprouts, season with salt, and serve scattered with coriander leaves and with a lime wedge on the side.
notes: Use rice noodles or thicker noodles. For children, omit chilli from the paste and add chilli sauce to adult portions at the table.
